name: Touba

queries.query: site:adm.sn Touba cadastre parcellaire foncier SIG commune registre parcelles
queries.scope: Find Touba-specific municipal/cadastral registry operations and any public full-geometry map service.
queries.result: The official ADM records a 2026 collaboration protocol with the Commune de Touba and later municipal-development planning workshops. The material inspected concerns city planning/development and does not document a parcel register, city cadastral office, or parcel GIS. DGID describes a Senegal-wide NICAD/cadastre process and local cadastral offices generally, but the sources inspected do not bind a particular office or published parcel dataset to Touba.
queries.executionMethod: Official Senegalese municipal-development and DGID searches/page inspection.

queries.query: Touba Senegal official city parcel cadastre municipal land registry public GIS map
queries.scope: Cross-check the local evidence and distinguish national cadastre procedures from a Touba-bound service.
queries.result: No official Touba-specific cadastral office or public parcel viewer/vector download was found. The DGID NICAD service requires local cadastral-office processing with title/allocation evidence, site plan, and owner ID; this national procedure is not proof of a Touba city source. No parcel geometry was returned.
queries.executionMethod: Official Senegal government source search and page inspection.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official ADM city-commune materials inspected relate to municipal development planning. National DGID guidance describes cadastral identifiers and a local-office application process, but no Touba-specific public viewer, parcel download, or service binding was verified.

technicalBlocker: No Touba-bound official cadastral register or anonymous public parcel-geometry source was verified. National DGID guidance and city planning cooperation are insufficient to establish a local parcel source.
remainingUncertainty: Touba’s unusual land-administration arrangements and any city-specific registry or project inventory are not documented by the public sources inspected. No absence claim is made.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The 2026 official ADM article documents cooperation between ADM and the Commune de Touba on municipal development. The DGID describes a national NICAD process delivered through the cadastral office local to a parcel, but the sources inspected do not identify an operating Touba cadastral office or a Touba parcel inventory. Registry status therefore remains unverified.
